title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.4
subtitle: Reliable modifier-stack playback without setup freezes.

highlights.title: Keep rig deformation active before the first bake
highlights.description: An empty or disabled Cloth NeXt boundary no longer switches off Armature or Corrective Smooth modifiers placed before it.

highlights.title: Avoid unnecessary scene evaluation
highlights.description: Registration skips the dependency-graph rebuild when playback state did not change, preventing a brief pause in heavy character scenes.
